QA-29122 is a PASS for the UCLA / University of California, Los Angeles row. The Viacom/MTV and Wasserman/Gatorade rows were not run.

- **Twitter only (32 posts):** Reactions + Comments + Shares equals Engagements on all 32 posts. The column totals also match the Sum row (464 + 25 + 83 = 572).
- **Instagram only (13 posts):** the identity holds on all 13 posts. Shares shows "–" on every Instagram post, so I treated it as 0, as the grid-math skill documents. The totals match the Sum row (10,486 + 155 + 0 = 10,641).

The run used the default week, 2026-10-12 to 2026-10-18, since the case doesn't give dates. The case had no open linked bugs, and no known bug interfered.

The Description table lists three Tuesday accounts, but the case's Notes define one account/brand per weekday, so I ran only the first Tuesday pair. The Notes also say "Tue UCLA/Sony Pictures", which contradicts the table (Sony Pictures is a Thursday account). I flagged that in the report for case cleanup.
